evidence: The three In Confidence title variants are Anatoly/Anatoliy Fedorovich Dobrynin's memoir; Sugubo doveritel'no is its Russian counterpart. The Soviet Union Today is his 1964 Detroit Economic Club speech. All 21 listed thesis-work counts belong to the Soviet ambassador.

Uma ciência moderna e imperial (8) and A emergência da biotipologia (1) are Ana Carolina Vimieiro Gomes's: 9/20 listed counts. O estado de exceção (two entries) is Ana Suelen Tossige Gomes's; the electricity works are Ana Amélia de Conti Gomes's; Crime em letra de forma is Ana Gomes Porto's. Several other fragments remain unassigned.

Borderlands of Western Civilization, Un Empereur de Byzance à Rome, The Crusade of Varna and From Florence to Brest are Oskar Halecki's. The remaining historical titles also belong to him. Persée explicitly associates Oscar and Oskar as forms of the same author's name.

O ideário urbano paulista (6) and Nem tudo era europeu (2) securely give Maia Costa 8/18 counts. Na Bahia Colonial is Luiz Monteiro da Costa's; Um Salto Planejado is Luiz Afonso Costa's; Camponeses e Política is Luiz Flávio de Carvalho Costa's; Classificando ocupações is Luiz Domingos Costa's. The bare Oculum ens fragment is unresolved; if his, the share reaches 9/18.

O Ipiranga apropriado (5) and Redutos da Ciência (1) are Ana Maria de Alencar Alves's: 6/19 listed counts. Iconologia do poder real (4) and As entradas régias portuguesas (2) are the Portuguese historian Ana Maria Alves's. Trabalho docente e proletarização is Ana Elizabeth Santos Alves's. The display name does not identify the museum historian.

The Exercise of Power catalogue gives Steve Boardman on the title and Stephen I. Boardman as the associated authority. The Cult of Saints and its Saintly Sinner chapter, the Campbell and Badenoch studies, and the collection with Julian Goodare are works of this same Scottish medieval historian. Steve/Stephen is a name variant.

The two Crescimento da população entries are José Francisco de Camargo's, totaling 9/21 counts. Distribuição de Renda with Giambiagi and A Revolução Indesejada are José Márcio Camargo's. Celso Furtado: os desafios do desenvolvimento is edited by José Marangoni Camargo with Corsi; the cronistas coloniais article is José Carlos Godoy Camargo's.

Both Papers of George Washington entries concern editor Philander D. Chase (8+7=15/21 counts). The Emergence of Culture, Hunters of Combe Grenal and the Paleolithic articles are archaeologist Philip G. Chase's (5 counts). Bishop Chase's Reminiscences is by the nineteenth-century bishop Philander Chase (1). Zero-count entries do not affect the share.

Education and Society (5), The 1848 Revolutions (2) and German Thought and Culture (1) are Hans-Joachim Hahn's: 8/18 counts. Vienna Circle works are Hans Hahn's; Die industrielle Revolution is Hans-Werner Hahn's; Die Vertreibung and the Hotel Lambert chapter are Hans Henning Hahn's; the material-culture works are Hans Peter Hahn's.

Mulheres e trabalhadoras (13) is Maria Valéria Junho Pena's; her Saúde nos Planos Nacionais de Desenvolvimento appeared in Dados in 1977 (1), giving about 14/17 counts. Escritura y política is María Antonia Peña's; the Hospital de La Latina convent chapter is María Rosa Fernández Peña's. The Belle époque article is another Spanish-language item, not evidence of the LC author's identity.
